concerns.text: Task T014d (Record Per‑Stimulus Metadata) lacks a concrete verification step. No test is specified to assert that JSON side‑car files are created, populated with the required fields, and linked to the stimuli.

Task T018a (Setup isolated test data directories in tests/data/) does not define any verification artifact (e.g., a test asserting the directories exist). Without a test, the task is not deterministically verifiable.
Task T066 (Hardware Profile Documentation) specifies creating documentation but provides no verification test or script to confirm the document exists or contains the required content.
Task T067 (RAM Limit Details) similarly lacks a verification step; no test or CI check is defined to ensure the RAM limit statement is present in the documentation.
